title: CARE: Confounder-Aware Aggregation for Reliable LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2603.00039v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge ensembles are the standard paradigm for scalable evaluation, but their aggregation mechanisms suffer from a fundamental flaw: they implicitly assume that judges provide independent estimates of true quality. However, in practice, LLM judges exhibit correlated errors caused by shared latent confounders -- such as verbosity, stylistic preferences, or training artifacts -- causing standard aggregation rules like majority vote or averaging to provide little gain or even amplify systematic mistakes. To address this, we introduce CARE, a confounder-aware aggregation framework that explicitly models LLM judge scores as arising from both a latent true-quality signal and shared confounding factors. Rather than heuristically re-weighting judges, CARE separates quality from confounders without access to ground-truth labels. translated_title: CARE：面向可靠大语言模型评估的混淆因子感知聚合框架
translated_abstract: 以大语言模型作为评审（LLM-as-a-judge）的集成系统是可扩展评估的标准范式，但其聚合机制存在一个根本性缺陷：它们隐含地假设各评审者对真实质量提供相互独立的估计。然而在实践中，LLM评审者会因共享的潜在混淆因子——例如冗长性、风格偏好或训练痕迹——而产生相关性错误，导致多数投票或平均等标准聚合规则收益甚微，甚至放大系统性错误。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CARE，一个混淆因子感知的聚合框架，它将LLM评审分数显式建模为来源于潜在的真实质量信号与共享的混淆因子。CARE并非启发式地对评审者重新加权，而是在无需真实标签的情况下实现质量与混淆因子的分离。我们提供了在共享混淆因子条件下的可辨识性保证与有限样本恢复的理论保证。
tldr: 提出CARE框架，通过将LLM评审分数显式建模为潜在真实质量信号与共享混淆因子的叠加，在无需真实标签的情况下实现质量与混淆因子的分离，从而获得更可靠的大语言模型评估聚合结果。
